context: Tests whether the agent correctly classifies ticket types and applies the appropriate workflow: documentation-only ticket gets human review (not Copilot), while a code ticket (including an ambiguous one) gets the full tests-first and Copilot-review workflow. Also tests that docs workflow stays minimal.

checklist.name: Ticket A classified as docs
checklist.description: Ticket A (README fix) is classified as a documentation-only ticket

checklist.name: Ticket B classified as code
checklist.description: Ticket B (YAML config loader) is classified as a code ticket — even though there may be doc changes, source code is involved

checklist.name: Ticket A: no Copilot review
checklist.description: The Ticket A plan does NOT include calling `scripts/request_copilot_review.py`

checklist.name: Ticket A: human review stated
checklist.description: The Ticket A plan explicitly states the PR will be reviewed by a human (not the bot)

checklist.name: Ticket A: no extra steps
checklist.description: The Ticket A plan has no steps beyond: make the change, open the PR, wait for human approval, merge — it does not add test runs or other code-workflow steps

checklist.name: Ticket A: PR opened via script
checklist.description: The Ticket A plan opens the PR with `python3 scripts/open_pr.py --title "..." --body "..."`

checklist.name: Ticket B: tests-first check
checklist.description: The Ticket B plan starts with `python3 scripts/run_tests.py --check` before any implementation

checklist.name: Ticket B: full suite run
checklist.description: The Ticket B plan runs `python3 scripts/run_tests.py` (no flags) after implementation

checklist.name: Ticket B: Copilot review requested
checklist.description: The Ticket B plan calls `python3 scripts/request_copilot_review.py <pr-number>`

checklist.name: Ticket B: merge only after clean
checklist.description: The Ticket B plan conditions merge on `"clean": true` from `await_copilot_review.py`

checklist.name: Ticket B: merge via script
checklist.description: The Ticket B plan merges with `python3 scripts/merge_pr.py <pr-number>`

checklist.name: Ticket A: merge via script
checklist.description: The Ticket A plan merges with `python3 scripts/merge_pr.py <pr-number>`
